title: Setting to add a keyboard shortcut does nothing
line: The Pager's keyboard shortcut now switches to the next virtual desktop, cycling back to the first after the last.
explanation: Every widget offers a Keyboard Shortcut setting that activates the widget, which normally acts like clicking it. The pager has no single click action (a click picks the desktop under the cursor), and it had no handler for activation, so the shortcut did nothing visible. The change adds an activation handler that switches to the next desktop (or activity, for the Activity Pager), wrapping from the last back to the first, as Nate suggested in the bug.

commits.message:
applets/pager: switch to the next desktop on the activation shortcut

The pager has no default click action, so the keyboard shortcut set in
its settings did nothing visible. Now activating the widget switches to
the next desktop, cycling back to the first one after the last.

BUG: 439707

reviews.text: Adding a Connections block on Plasmoid.onActivated to cycle pagerModel.changePage((pagerModel.currentPage + 1) % repeater.count) when repeater.count > 1 cleanly implements Nate's suggestion for both the Virtual Desktop and Activity Pagers. Always wrapping is the right UX for a single activation shortcut, the > 1 guard prevents division by zero or accidentally toggling Show Desktop, and verification confirms the fix without regressions.

Implements exactly what Nate proposed in c4: an onActivated handler in the pager's main.qml that moves to the next desktop or activity. It is guarded against a single page, so it can never call changePage() on the current page and toggle Show Desktop. Small, right place (the applet owns its activation behaviour), and the before/after shots plus the D-Bus check show 1->2->3->1. Nits: wrapping always on regardless of the widget's 'Navigation wraps around' option is a defensible choice but may come up in review, and the rig ran on an empty desktop, so it wasn't checked whether the existing activation (setExpanded/panel focus) still takes keyboard focus away from an app window after the switch.
